question: Should Docker/Podman runtime containers expose the agent workspace at `/workspace`, or should `/workspace` remain reserved for sandbox containers with docs/templates using the runtime home path?
rationale: Both outcomes are plausible, but the choice affects container setup behavior, Podman/Docker parity, and sandbox path semantics across user-facing install surfaces.

options.title: Implement a consistent runtime alias
options.body: Add a `/workspace` alias or bind contract across Dockerfile, Compose, setup helpers, Podman/Quadlet, docs, and smoke coverage.

options.title: Document sandbox-only semantics
options.body: Keep runtime containers on `/home/node/.openclaw/workspace` and remove or avoid any docs/templates that imply `/workspace` is generally available.

options.title: Defer behind Docker sandbox path work
options.body: Resolve the adjacent Docker-outside-of-Docker sandbox path contract first, then apply one workspace path policy to runtime and sandbox containers.

recommendation.title: Implement a consistent runtime alias
recommendation.body: Add a `/workspace` alias or bind contract across Dockerfile, Compose, setup helpers, Podman/Quadlet, docs, and smoke coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent Docker runtime packaging history and already participated in canonical triage for the adjacent Docker workspace path issue.
